items.title: Pay veterinary invoice TA-26-1187
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 17.04.2026. Per §187 Abs. 1 BGB, since the period runs from an event (the invoice date), that day itself is not counted; counting starts 18.04.2026. Counting 14 days forward from 18.04.2026 lands on 01.05.2026 (day 14). 01.05.2026 is a Friday and is 'Tag der Arbeit', a statutory public holiday nationwide including NRW. Per §193 BGB, if the last day of a period falls on a Sunday, Saturday, or recognized public holiday, it is replaced by the next business day (Werktag). The following day, 02.05.2026, is a Saturday, and 03.05.2026 is a Sunday, so the next business day is Monday, 04.05.2026.
